LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingRemoteContro: Remote control of vehicles by radio

On by default. A vehicle fitted with a control radio can be driven from a radio station with nobody aboard: draft it and give it orders as usual. If it loses its link, it waits a few seconds and then does what you chose for it: hold, come back toward its station, or finish its last drive. Off, no vehicle is driven from a station, and one already driving stops where it is.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingRemoteKeepTo: Vehicles driven from afar keep to radio cover

On by default. A vehicle driven from a radio station prefers a way where its stations can still reach it, and goes round ground behind hills, rock and thick walls where it would lose its link, if the way round is not too much longer. It never refuses an order: sent somewhere out of reach, it still goes, and loses its link there. The map of where the stations reach is worked out a little at a time after a station, an antenna, a wall or a roof changes. Off, a vehicle driven from afar takes the same way it would with a driver.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingRemoteGunsFi: Remote guns fire on their own

Off by default. A gun that no seat works, such as a remote weapon station, on a vehicle fitted with the remote control kit, fires only while a radio station's operator has the vehicle's picture and can watch what it shoots at. On, it fires at enemies by itself, with nobody watching: it may waste ammunition, start a fight early or shoot through friends. Vehicles without the kit fire as their makers built them, either way.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingRouteControl: Vehicles follow a leader and run loops by themselves

On by default. A vehicle fitted with the route kit can follow a crewed vehicle in a convoy, up to four behind one leader, or run back and forth between two stops you mark, with nobody aboard. If its leader is lost it does what you chose for it: hold, come back or carry on. Off, no vehicle follows or runs a loop, and one doing so stops.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingMechControlD: On by default. A vehicle fitted with the mech control link can be linked to one of your mechanitors, who then drives it with nobody aboard, within their command range, as they command mechanoids. It takes some of their bandwidth by its size: 1 for a light vehicle, 2 for a medium one, 3 for a heavy or tracked one. Mechanoids come first: when bandwidth runs short, the newest linked vehicle loses control first. Off, no mechanitor drives a vehicle, and one driven so stops.
LanguageData.PhobosRemote_GizmoDriveDesc: Lets a radio station drive this vehicle while nobody is at its wheel: once a station has it, draft it and give it orders as usual. It holds a control channel at that station while this is on, and a colonist at the wheel still drives it the ordinary way. Turn it off to park it and free the channel.

LanguageData.PhobosRemote_LostCarryOn: It is finishing the drive it was given, and will wait there.

LanguageData.PhobosRoute_GizmoFollowDesc: Choose a vehicle to follow with nobody aboard: it joins the end of that vehicle's convoy, up to {MOST} behind one leader. The leader needs someone at its wheel, or a station driving it; if the leader is lost, this vehicle does what you chose for a lost link.
LanguageData.PhobosRoute_GizmoLoopDesc: Mark two stops, the pick-up first and then the drop-off: the vehicle drives back and forth between them with nobody aboard, waiting an hour at each for colonists to load or unload it. A truck that tips unloads itself at the drop-off, backing up to a bunker or stockpile the stop is on, and one with a loading grab loads itself at the pick-up with what its Gather what allows; each drives on as soon as it is done. Add waypoints afterwards to send it a certain way.
LanguageData.PhobosRoute_GizmoWaypointDesc: Choose a spot the vehicle must pass on its loop. It goes on the way out or the way back, whichever it lengthens least.
LanguageData.PhobosRoute_GizmoStopFollowingDesc: Leaves the convoy and stops where it is. Any vehicle behind it closes up on the one ahead.
LanguageData.PhobosRoute_GizmoStopLoopDesc: Stops where it is and forgets its loop.
LanguageData.PhobosRoute_GizmoBreakUpDesc: Every vehicle following this one stops following and stays where it is.

LanguageData.PhobosRoute_BrokenUp: {VEHICLE}'s convoy breaks up; each vehicle stays where it is.
